_meta.description: Master alias dictionary for entity normalisation across all 7 Kandas

hanuman.role: Devoted minister of Sugriva, messenger and champion of Rama

rama.role: Prince of Ayodhya, seventh avatar of Vishnu, hero of the Ramayana

sita.role: Princess of Mithila, wife of Rama, daughter of King Janaka

ravana.role: King of Lanka, ten-headed demon king, principal antagonist

lakshmana.role: Younger brother of Rama, loyal companion throughout exile

sugriva.role: King of Kishkindha, ally of Rama, younger brother of Vali

vali.role: Former king of Kishkindha, elder brother of Sugriva, slain by Rama

vibhishana.role: Righteous younger brother of Ravana who defected to Rama's side

jatayu.role: Aged vulture king, friend of Dasharatha, who battled Ravana to protect Sita

kumbhakarna.role: Younger brother of Ravana, giant warrior who sleeps six months at a stretch

indrajit.role: Son of Ravana, greatest warrior of Lanka, conqueror of Indra

dasharatha.role: King of Ayodhya, father of Rama, Bharata, Lakshmana and Shatrughna

angada.role: Son of Vali, prince of Kishkindha, commander in Rama's army

trijata.role: Kind rakshasi in Ashoka grove who consoled and protected Sita

lankini.role: Demoness guardian of Lanka's gates, defeated by Hanuman at entry

surpanakha.role: Sister of Ravana whose disfigurement by Lakshmana triggered the war

mareecha.role: Rakshasa uncle of Ravana who took the form of a golden deer to lure Rama

shabari.role: Devoted tribal ascetic who waited years for Rama and offered him tasted berries

sampati.role: Elder brother of Jatayu who provided intelligence on Sita's whereabouts in Lanka

nala.role: Vanara architect who designed and supervised the bridge to Lanka

neela.role: Vanara general and son of Agni who helped construct the bridge to Lanka

narada.role: Divine sage and celestial messenger who narrates the Ramayana summary to Valmiki

valmiki.role: Sage and author of the Ramayana, who shelters Sita in his hermitage

brahma.role: Creator god of the Hindu trinity, grandfather of all beings

vishvamitra.role: Brahmarishi sage who escorts young Rama and Lakshmana and teaches them divine weapons

bharata.role: Son of Dasharatha and Kaikeyi, devoted brother who rules Ayodhya in Rama's name during exile

shatrughna.role: Youngest son of Dasharatha, twin of Lakshmana and devoted companion of Bharata

kaikeyi.role: Second queen of Dasharatha, mother of Bharata, whose boons cause Rama's exile

kausalya.role: First and chief queen of Dasharatha, mother of Rama

sumitra.role: Third queen of Dasharatha, mother of Lakshmana and Shatrughna

janaka.role: King of Mithila and father of Sita who arranged the svayamvara with Shiva's bow

guha.role: King of the Nishada tribe and loyal friend of Rama who helps him cross the Ganga

manthara.role: Hunchbacked maid of Kaikeyi who instigates her to demand Rama's exile

vashistha.role: Royal sage and Brahmarishi, guru and family priest of the Ikshvaku dynasty of Ayodhya

indra.role: King of the gods and heavens, father of Vali, who aids Rama in battle

ayodhya.description: Capital of the Kosala kingdom, birthplace of Rama

kishkindha.description: Vanara kingdom ruled by Vali and later Sugriva

dandaka_forest.description: Dense forest where Rama, Sita and Lakshmana spent most of their exile

mithila.description: Kingdom of Janaka, birthplace of Sita

pushpaka_vimana.description: Celestial flying chariot originally belonging to Kubera, seized by Ravana

shiva_dhanush.description: Bow of Lord Shiva broken by Rama at Sita's svayamvara

sanjeevani.description: Life-restoring herb fetched by Hanuman from Dronagiri mountain

chudamani.description: Sita's hair jewel given to Hanuman as proof of their meeting in Lanka

brahmastra.description: Supremely powerful divine weapon of Brahma, invoked in key battles

normalization_rules.description: Rules for normalising Sanskrit diacritics to ASCII for alias matching
rules: Apply diacritic_map character substitutions before any matching
Lowercase all text when case_fold is true
Collapse multiple internal spaces to single space
Remove punctuation when strip_punctuation is true before alias lookup
